quality_anchors: Validate duplicate task ids, missing runners, unknown dependencies, and dependency cycles when creating the runner.
Run each task only after dependencies pass, preserve deterministic dependency order, and record the actual run order.
Pass each runner a context with original input fields plus successful prior results.
Retry failed tasks according to the retries budget and record attempts plus a useful error message.
Skip downstream tasks when a dependency failed or was skipped, with skipped_due_to evidence.
Format a concise Markdown report from the final workflow result.
